prompt:
Edit the supplied table into a TRUE LOW-RESOLUTION GAME SPRITE. Keep its camera, deep oval top, thin front rim, short attached front legs, ONE cream jug and TWO terracotta cups. The current fine source shrinks badly. REDRAW using exactly a 32-COLUMN by 24-ROW LOGICAL PIXEL GRID. Every logical pixel is one solid hard square. Render that grid enlarged as identical 32x32 squares on a 1024x768 transparent canvas; absolutely no marks smaller than one logical pixel. This is pixel art, not an illustration with a pixel filter.
Make the oval table approximately 30 logical pixels wide and 16 pixels deep with short 2-pixel legs below. Use 12–16 colours total. Thin selective one-logical-pixel warm-dark-brown silhouette, TWO wood fill tones with a small upper-left edge highlight; at most two simple plank seams, NO grain texture.
Most important: distinguish the pottery at NATIVE 32x24 resolution. Make the cream jug about 5 pixels wide by 6 pixels tall including a readable side HANDLE and dark top mouth. Make each terracotta cup 3 pixels wide by 3 pixels tall, with a dark centre pixel and a visibly lighter terracotta rim. Space the three items apart, one cup left of jug and the other cup to its right/below, so none merge. Use a light warm terracotta that contrasts with the walnut tabletop. Keep most of the tabletop clear.
Maintain orthographic angled top-down RPG camera from the interior reference: substantial tabletop top surface, one-pixel shaded front rim, rear legs hidden, short front legs, horizontal width axis, no isometric diamond/convergence/front view. One complete centered table, transparent padding, binary transparent background including all gaps, bottom feet above the canvas bottom padding. No ground shadow, floor, scenery, other object, labels, text, borders, anti-aliasing, gradients, noise, dithering, blur, realistic texture or heavy black outlines.
